0.description: Low: external JS <=50 KB gzip, eager media <=120 KB, CSS <=15 KB, with no meaningful remaining delivery concern.

1.description: Moderate: critical assets are controlled, but font delivery or one remaining asset offers a meaningful optimization.

2.description: High: external JS >100 KB gzip or eager media >350 KB, with multiple material problems.

3.description: Severe: several megabytes critical or known render-blocking work.

1.description: Partial: a few sizes without route attribution.

2.description: Strong for route payload conclusions, limited for runtime and Core Web Vitals.

3.description: Conclusive: includes lab or field Core Web Vitals and CPU/resource traces.
